event.title: Nagasaki Commemorates 81st Anniversary of Atomic Bombing
event.canonical_title: Nagasaki Commemorates 81st Anniversary of Atomic Bombing
event.summary: On the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing of Nagasaki, Mayor Shiro Suzuki condemned the increasing global support for nuclear deterrence, asserting that 'humanity and nuclear weapons cannot coexist.' He labeled nuclear weapons as 'absolute evil' and urged the Japanese government to uphold its non-nuclear principles established after World War II.
